text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle made it safely through May 
of the Classic Year, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No sense of rivalry blooms toward her 
classmates, the God of Destruction Tanino 
Gimlet or the professional Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's missing is "resolve." And a lack of 
awareness—feeling like she hasn't done 
enough despite putting in proper "effort."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being conscious of one's own efforts leads 
to confidence. They decided to 
revolutionize her mindset before the next 
goal, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
